title: The hours card
venue: the coast community-college paper, Newport · the laundromat digest
source: lore/drift_wood/_THE_COMPLETE_RUN.md (1999–2000 · deepening xix · the daily filled)
logline: Friday. The owner has lettered a new HOURS card for the window: TUE / THU / SAT. Wood's days, in her hand. The strip draws the card. It's the first time the strip's own schedule is on a sign the world made.

panels.composition: The shop window: a hand-lettered card, HOURS: TUE · THU · SAT · 10–4, in the OWNER's neat capitals.

image.prompt: close on a hand-lettered hours card in a shop window in neat capitals, black and white, no words
image.notes: Letter after: HOURS · TUE · THU · SAT · 10–4 (locations.md: the 2000 card).

panels.composition: WOOD outside on the gravel, looking at it. BARNABY. Not a shop day; he came to look.

image.prompt: a young man on a gravel lot looking at a small card in a shop window, a dog beside him, black and white, no words

panels.composition: The card, close. His days. Her hand.

image.prompt: close on neat hand-lettered capitals on a white card in a window, black and white, no words

panels.composition: The shop from the road with the card in the window. The strip's schedule on a sign the world made. The strip finds this more official than the roster.

image.prompt: a low roadside frame shop seen from the highway with a small card visible in its window, black and white, no words

art.line: brush-pen, committed; black and white; xerox

notes: TUE · THU · SAT, in her hand. More official than the roster.
